description.en: Specifies whether to restart the gateway after the agent is created. The default value is `true`.
The absolute path of the agent workspace.

descriptions.zh:
## 请求说明
通过此API，用户能够创建一个PolarClaw Agent，并且可以选择性地为其设置`Emoji`（表情）与`Avatar`（头像）。
descriptions.en:
## Description

Use this operation to create a PolarClaw Agent. You can optionally specify an `emoji` and an `avatar`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb create-polar-claw-agent --application-id pa-00000000000000 --agent-id work --workspace /home/node/.openclaw/workspace-work --emoji U+1F99E --avatar test --restart true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb CreatePolarClawAgent --region cn-hangzhou --Emoji 'U+1F99E' --AgentId work --ApplicationId 'pa-00000000000000' --Restart true --Avatar test --Workspace '/home/node/.openclaw/workspace-work'
